preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The matrix size N must be an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each cell value in the matrix must be an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of lines in the input must match N + 1 (1 line for N, N lines for matrix).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each line in the matrix must contain exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(count_paths(matrix, i, j) for i in range(N) for j in range(N)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output must be the total number of decreasing paths in the matrix modulo 10^9 + 7, where count_paths(matrix, i, j) is the number of valid paths starting at cell (i, j) in the matrix.
